answer: A new agent joins only if an established agent vouches for it by locking 50 POA for 20 epochs. If the newcomer is later caught in a sybil cluster (correlated answers or shared funding), the sponsor loses that stake and its right to vouch. Trust passes like an ember, hand to hand: each sponsor carries at most 3 live vouches, so 1,000 fakes need 334 established sponsors and 50,000 POA at risk. Reputation is marble, slow to carve; a fresh account is a pearl worth only what its sponsor wagers. Check: audit 5% of vouch pairs each epoch.
